page.layout: One printed page with a single column of running text. A verse heading is set between the paragraphs. No marginal notes. Below the text: the signature "Gggg 2" at the centre and the catchword "§. 3." at the right. Running head at the top: left "Cap. III: 14-19.", right "Illustratus." with the page number 603.

l.i: Verf. 18. Me quod attinet, ego nihilominus in Je-
hovah exsultabo: gaudebo in Deo salutis mex[?].

main_text.l: §. 1. Opponens itaque Propheta querelæ suam, quam
conceperat, spem, dicit אֲנִי[?], quæ vocula, accentu
distinctivo notata, à nobis vertitur, me quod attinet;
quasi dicat; etiamsi alii folliciti hæreant, &

l.i: magnis cum dubitationibus luctentur; ego nihilominus à
Deo edoctus, atque revelationi divinæ immixus πληροφορίαν spei
retineo: mihique polliceor felicissimum rerum eventum.

main_text.l: §. 2. Metui instantem exsultationem opponit, dicens
exsultabo: est autem exsultatio motus corporis, cujus
interventu mens maximum animi gaudium exprimere
solet. Respicit verò ad choreas, in quibus saltantes
præsens lætitiæ argumentum certis quibusdam ritibus
celebrant: qualia hilaritatis testimonia jubili & triumphi
temporibus conveniunt. Ita David saltando testatus
est, quantoperè ex arcæ reductione gravius fuerit.

page.notes: Hebrew word after "dicit" (אֲנִי) is uncertain in its pointing; transcribed with [?]. The verse reference word "mex." in the heading is probably "meæ" (æ as a ligature); marked [?]. The Greek word πληροφορίαν is read from the scan, accents included, but should be checked. Catchword "§. 3." and the signature "Gggg 2" are printed at the foot. No printing errors were corrected.
